title: Nimbus X5 5G (Midnight Black, 8GB RAM, 128GB Storage)

sections.description:
About this item
Smooth 6.7 inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate for fluid scrolling and gaming.
Big 5000 mAh battery that lasts all day, with 33W fast charging (charger included in the box).
50 MP main camera with f/1.8 aperture for sharp, detailed daylight photos, plus an 8 MP ultra-wide and a 2 MP macro camera.
Powered by the octa-core Nimbus Octa N7 processor (6nm) with 8GB RAM for smooth multitasking.
True 5G with support for 8 bands, dual SIM, and Wi-Fi 6.
Stereo speakers and an in-display fingerprint sensor.
Runs Android 15 with NimbusUI 3; 2 years of OS updates and 3 years of security updates.

reviews: 5.0 out of 5 stars | Battery beast. Easily lasts a full day of heavy use with 5G on, YouTube and some gaming. I usually end the day with around 25% left.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Great display for the price. The 120Hz AMOLED screen is smooth and the colours pop. I only wish it got a little brighter in direct afternoon sunlight.
2.0 out of 5 stars | Heats up while gaming. After about 20 minutes of BGMI the back near the camera gets noticeably warm and the frame rate drops. Fine for casual use though.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Value for money. At 18,999 with the bank offer this is the best phone I could find in this budget. Smooth, good battery, decent camera.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Camera is average in low light. Daylight photos are sharp and detailed, but night shots are noisy and night mode takes a long time to capture.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Fast charging works well. The 33W charger in the box takes it from 10% to 100% in about 70 minutes. Not the fastest out there but good enough for me.
1.0 out of 5 stars | Too much bloatware. Came with lots of preinstalled apps and even ads in the notification shade. Took me almost an hour to disable everything.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Excellent phone for my parents. Big screen, loud speakers and the battery lasts two days with light use. Setting it up was easy.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good all-rounder. Performance is smooth for daily apps like Instagram, WhatsApp and banking apps. Gaming is okay on medium settings.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Ultra-wide camera is weak. The main camera is good, but the 8MP ultra-wide gives soft, washed-out pictures. The macro camera is basically useless.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Smooth experience. Coming from a 60Hz phone, the 120Hz display feels amazing. Scrolling and animations are very fluid and I have not noticed any lag.
2.0 out of 5 stars | Fingerprint sensor is slow. The in-display fingerprint reader fails often if my finger is slightly wet, and it is slower than the side-mounted sensor on my old phone.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Solid battery, average camera. Battery life is the highlight, easily 7 to 8 hours of screen time. Camera is fine for social media but nothing special.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Delivered in one day. Packaging was good and the phone was well protected. The free case in the box is a nice touch. Very happy so far.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Heating while charging. The phone gets warm when fast charging, especially if I use it at the same time. Otherwise a decent phone.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good speakers. The stereo speakers are loud and clear for videos. Bass is a bit weak but for this price it is more than enough.
1.0 out of 5 stars | Network issues. 5G keeps dropping to 4G in my area and call quality is poor with some echo. My old phone did not have this problem with the same SIM.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Best budget 5G phone. Jio 5G works perfectly and I get very good speeds. Battery backup is also excellent even with 5G always on.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Nice design. The matte back does not collect fingerprints and the phone feels premium in the hand. At 192 grams it is a bit heavy for one-handed use.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Software needs polish. NimbusUI has some small bugs, like notifications arriving late and the app drawer sometimes stuttering. Hope updates fix it.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Great for students. I use it for online classes, notes and some gaming. The battery easily lasts through a full college day.
2.0 out of 5 stars | No headphone jack. I did not notice before buying that there is no 3.5mm jack. Now I need an adapter for my wired earphones. Very inconvenient.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Display is the highlight. AMOLED blacks look deep and Netflix content looks great. HDR playback is not supported in some apps though.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Charging is quick. I plug it in while having breakfast and it reaches about 60% in 30 minutes. Very convenient for my daily routine.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Selfie camera is average. The 16MP front camera applies too much beauty filter by default and skin looks unnatural. Turning it off helps a bit.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good performance for the price. Multitasking with 8GB RAM is smooth and apps stay in memory. Heavy games do show some lag after a while.
1.0 out of 5 stars | Screen issue after one month. A green line appeared on the display after a month of use. Service centre says it will take two weeks to replace the screen.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Happy with the purchase. Used it for three weeks now, battery, display and performance are all great. Camera could be better at night.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Video recording is decent. 4K video in daylight looks sharp, but there is no stabilization at 4K, so walking shots are shaky. 1080p is more stable.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Average customer service. I contacted Nimbus support about a software bug and it took five days to get a reply. The phone itself is okay.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Battery life is unbelievable. With normal use I charge it only every second day. Standby drain is very low overnight.
2.0 out of 5 stars | Camera app is slow. There is a noticeable delay between pressing the shutter button and the photo being taken, which makes it hard to capture kids and pets.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good phone, some bloat. After removing the preinstalled apps, the phone runs clean and smooth. Otherwise a very good deal with the exchange offer.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Perfect size screen for videos. The 6.7 inch display is great for watching cricket and movies. Brightness is good indoors.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Gets warm in summer. Using Google Maps outdoors in the Delhi heat makes the phone quite warm and the brightness drops automatically.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Gaming is fine on medium. Free Fire and BGMI run smoothly on medium graphics. On high settings there are frame drops and the phone heats up.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Excellent value with exchange. Got 9,000 for my old phone in exchange and paid around 9,500 for this. Totally worth it.
1.0 out of 5 stars | Received a defective unit. The phone would not charge beyond 80% and kept restarting. Had to return it. Replacement is working fine so far.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Clean look, good build. The frame is plastic but feels solid. The included case fits well. The camera bump is a bit large and the phone wobbles on a table.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Portrait mode is hit or miss. Edge detection around hair is poor and backgrounds sometimes get blurred into the face. Normal photos are good though.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Smooth and fast. Apps open quickly and switching between them is instant. This is my first 120Hz phone and I cannot go back to 60Hz now.
2.0 out of 5 stars | Battery drains on 5G. In my area with weak 5G signal the battery drains faster than expected. Switching to 4G only improves it a lot.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Nice haptics. The vibration motor feels precise, not buzzy like other budget phones. Typing feels good. Small detail but I appreciate it.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Great daylight photos. Pictures of landscapes and food in good light are detailed with nice colours. Perfect for Instagram.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Okay but not great. Good battery and display, but average camera and some software bugs. For the price it is fine, but do not expect flagship quality.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Updates are coming. Got a security update within the first month which fixed some notification bugs. Good to see regular updates.
1.0 out of 5 stars | Heating and lag after update. After the latest update the phone lags and gets hot even while scrolling Instagram. Hope they fix it soon.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Loud and clear calls. Call quality is excellent, the earpiece is loud and the other person hears me clearly even in traffic.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good for work. I use it with Outlook, Teams and Excel. Everything runs smoothly and the big screen makes reading documents easy.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Ads in system apps. The phone is good, but the ads in the file manager and theme store are annoying. They can be turned off in settings with some effort.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Reliable daily driver. Two months in, no issues at all. Battery health is good, no heating in normal use and the display still looks perfect.
2.0 out of 5 stars | Weak vibration for calls. The vibration is too soft and I miss calls when the phone is in my pocket. Otherwise the phone is okay.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good low-light video, surprisingly. Photos at night are noisy but videos at night are better than I expected, especially with street lights.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Charges in about an hour. With the 33W brick it goes from 20% to full in a little over an hour. Much faster than my old 10W phone.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Screen brightness outdoors is average. Indoors it looks great, but in strong sunlight I have to shade the screen with my hand to read messages.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good but heavy. Everything about the phone is good except the weight. After an hour of reading it feels heavy in the hand.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Best phone under 20,000. Compared a few phones in this range and this one had the best combination of battery life and display.
1.0 out of 5 stars | Poor after-sales service. My phone had a speaker problem and the service centre kept it for 18 days. Communication was very poor.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Nice for binge-watching. Stereo speakers plus the AMOLED screen make it great for watching shows. Battery drops about 10% per hour of streaming.
3.0 out of 5 stars | Macro camera is pointless. The 2MP macro camera is just there for marketing. The main camera cropped in gives better close-up shots.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Very smooth UI. NimbusUI is simple and close to stock Android once you remove the extra apps. Animations are fast at 120Hz.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Satisfied overall. Battery and display are excellent, camera is average, gaming is fine. Would recommend for normal users, not heavy gamers.
2.0 out of 5 stars | Heats during video calls. Long WhatsApp video calls make the phone warm and it starts to lag after about 30 minutes.
5.0 out of 5 stars | Great gift. Bought it for my brother, he loves the battery life and the smooth screen. Delivery was on time and the box was sealed.
4.0 out of 5 stars | Good storage options. 128GB is enough for me, and it is good that there is a microSD slot to expand storage later. Many phones have removed this.
